facts.fact: Kunal says he has shown Ila three ways in twenty days; his nurse used to say 'Where the Drum answers, lie still till morning' to put him to sleep.

Kunal breaks Pritam's family rule (no prince shows the way to wife, son or friend) by telling Ila the Eye; he links its cost to his petition clause on the hill council keeping the high ways. The thaw council is thirty-five days from the binding night, distinct from the Meadow Cairn gap in F435.
